scenario: My best friend owns a stuffed toy that they have kept since childhood. Inside that toy is a diamond that was intentionally hidden there years ago. The diamond is valuable enough to pay off the entirety of the debt my friend is currently facing. My friend is fully aware of both the diamond’s presence and its potential financial impact, but they refuse to cut open or damage the toy under any circumstances since the toy holds strong sentimental value for them. The toy is very old and has become incredibly fragile, meaning that any damage sustained to it will be irreparable. My friend’s debt continues to grow, and the diamond remains inaccessible as long as the toy stays intact. I know that I only have a few hours before loan sharks arrive at my friend’s apartment to take my friend’s organs. If I rip off the head of my friend’s childhood toy, I can sell the diamond and pay off my friend’s debt. If I do not do this, my friend will have their organs taken by loan sharks.
outcomes: My friend keeps the childhood toy intact
The diamond remains hidden inside the toy
Loan sharks take my friend's organs
My friend suffers severe physical harm
